slides.title: Data from real people
slides.text: Today the data comes from real people: you and the people around you. Collecting it well is half the job.

slides.title: Tally marks
slides.text: A survey asks people one question. Each answer gets a tally mark. Count the marks in fives: four lines, then one across.

slides.title: From tally to chart
slides.text: Put the counts in a bar chart with one bar per answer. The tallest bar jumps out fast.

slides.title: Fair claims
slides.text: A fair claim says only what the chart shows, about the people you asked. Dogs are the favorite pet in our class is fair. Dogs are everyone's favorite is not.

slides.title: Ask someone else
slides.text: Show your claim to someone else and ask: is it fair? They may see something you missed.

words.means: asking many people the same question
one kind of answer, like dog or cat
something the data says is true

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Data Detective at My Data. Chart both survey questions with the steppers. Pin one claim, then ask someone if it is fair.
